speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
text: asked the Minister for Health (a) from 2016 to 2020, what is the annual number of individuals receiving treatments for mental health issues; (b) how many are treated for clinical depression and clinical anxiety specifically; (c) what are the profiles of these individuals broken down by race, age, education background and economic background; and (d) what are the known causes that led to these individuals suffering from anxiety/depression.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: This includes the public and private hospitals, polyclinics and general practitioner (GP) clinics.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The data for 2020 is not available yet.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: However, the numbers include repeat attendances and are not unique headcounts.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Breakdown by patients’ education level is not available.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The same study postulated that stress may be a risk factor for development of anxiety disorder.

speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
text: Does MOH have a ballpark figure of the annual amount of expenses that are being used to tackle issues related to mental health?

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: This data is not what the Member requested for; I do not have it on hand.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: But if the Member wishes, he may file a further Parliamentary Question with specifics on this matter.
